visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator (Allen) with short black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and a blue wristwatch, is seated in a brightly lit indoor room with a light gray tiled wall. He holds a black smartphone and speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face. On the left third of the frame, a persistent vertical banner displays the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra in three colors along with text promotional details. (2) The scene transitions to a high-definition screen recording of a smartphone interface demonstrating an 'Audio Eraser' tool. Allen appears in a small picture-in-picture box in the bottom corner. A digital slider is adjusted by an unseen hand to filter out background noise, moving from -48 to -100. (3) Allen is shown in a split-screen layout, gesturing enthusiastically while discussing the phone's hardware. Extreme close-ups follow, showcasing the titanium-textured edges and the vertical triple-lens camera module of the device from multiple cinematic angles. (4) The video displays several screen captures of the Samsung Shop APP, highlighting limited-time offers like a '破萬元' discount and 24-month warranty coverage. Allen's video continues in a side panel as he explains these benefits. (5) Allen makes a shaka hand gesture and points toward the camera as yellow variety-style text showing the promo code 'MEN2504' appears next to him. The video concludes with a static graphic featuring the Samsung Shop APP logo and call-to-action text against a white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a male staff voice prompting the creator, followed immediately by Allen's energetic response identifying background noise. The mix is initially dry with clear studio room tone. (2) A rhythmic pop BGM (~105 BPM) featuring clean electronic percussion and synth chords fades in as Allen begins his pitch. His voice quality is enunciated and high-arousal. (3) A distinct transition occurs as loud environmental traffic noise is introduced for a demonstration. This noise is then filtered away through the 'Audio Eraser' tool, leaving Allen's voice perfectly clear against the BGM. (4) As the narration shifts to promotional details, the speech rate increases significantly. A sharp 'ding' sound effect and digital UI click sounds are layered over the mix to highlight discount graphics and app buttons. (5) The final phase features a confident, high-valence call-to-action from Allen. The music tempo remains steady until a brief swell and a sharp hard cut at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the AI audio-editing capabilities and premium hardware design of the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, while incentivizing downloads of the Samsung Shop APP through exclusive discounts and a creator promo code.
